ratings.comment: Grading is subjective to how much he finds projects entertaining. Students are teaching themselves and classmates material. Late penalties start at 25%. No empathy for students. Brags about how hard it is to receive a 100%. Quizzes are too short in time considering how beefy each question is. Mentally unstimulating and draining at the same time.

Dan may be a good person, but definitely not a good professor.

He doesn't lecture (everything is based on a textbook and students' work). He is a harsh grader, not accessible, and is not open to feedback (once made a statement in class about his disagreement with feedback on not lecturing and why he is right).

If you can, avoid taking his class.

Dan tried to not come off as the bad guy. He really didnt want students to hate how harsh the grading was, and how easy it was to fail the quizzes. But, Dan simply did not teach at all. Way too many group projects. These made it easier for him to not teach. This class stressed me out much more than it needed to.

Dan has students present chapters from the textbook instead of a traditional lecture. However, he wants it to be in an engaging format so we end up with the presentations being based on game shows that teach you barely anything. HE DOESN'T TEACH ANYTHING. The quizzes and tests specifically reference throwaway comments he makes in lecture.

Dan's class is set up so that he doesn't have to lift a finger during lectures. His students are the ones teaching, and if they don't know the material for projects, quizzes, or papers, Dan ensures they are penalized. If you value your mental sanity, I wouldn't recommend taking his course.

Dan literally did nothing for the class. He made us do these stupid group presentations on the textbook chapters instead of lecturing. He didn't TEACH. Everything was through the textbook and that's the only way we got content. The quizzes were so hard because he said only 4 people in the class can get an A. Extremely harsh grader on group projects
Never teaches a class, it is all self studying

Extremely boring class but required for Bschool, all exams, assignments, readings are online, a few group projects, not a hard class but has to maintain a 3.2 GPA class average so not everyone earns an "A" even if they fall above a 93%. Dan is nice but not engaging at all.
